## Before downloading

1. Generate with the PulseDB code from MIMIC-III and VitalDB, then ingest the output.
2. Download all files into one folder, keeping the provider's folder structure.

## Credentials

None. The tool reads no credentials for it.

## Get the data

Download the files into a folder as the steps above say, then import the folder:

```bash
biosignal-data import pulsedb/pulsedb <folder you downloaded into> --version <label> --dest s3://<bucket>
```
